item.title: My first GitHub repo - a simple Hello World for beginners
item.description:
I just created my first repository on GitHub! 🎉

After putting it off for months, I finally took the plunge and learned Git. This "Hello-World" repository is my way of documenting the journey.

For anyone else who's been hesitant to start with version control:

item.title: Defuddle Turns Any Web Page Into Clean Markdown From the Terminal
item.description: You have seen the problem. You want the article. The page gives you the article plus a sidebar, a comments section, a cookie notice, four related posts injected into the body, and whatever else the CMS decided to throw in. Defuddle strips all of that. It extracts the main content from a web page and returns it as clean HTML or Markdown. One library, one job. item.description: As a developer building payment systems, one of the most frustrating experiences is not knowing what “success” actually means. A transfer request goes through, the API responds fine, and your webhook fires. But the status says pending. Has the money moved or not?
